notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Hollow Sentinel, adding {U}.
Repeat.
